title: Viktor Code
lede: Viktor Code is a coding agent that takes a business goal instead of a ticket, draws on company context from chat, support, analytics and billing tools, and returns pull requests for review.

points: It splits a goal into the engineering work and the non-code work around it, such as a pricing page or a note to customers.
Connects to repos on GitHub, GitLab or Bitbucket, and to Slack, Teams or Discord.
Projects belong to the whole team, so anyone can follow what is being built, see the reasoning, and take it over.
The team says one engineer merged 228 PRs from about two hours of coding time spread over two days.
It is built for work that runs hours or days; the team warns it will feel slow on quick edits.

sections.text: Teams that want non-engineers to ship changes, and engineers handing off multi-day work that depends on business context.
Free to start, with up to $100 in credits, according to the launch description.
